description: Defines the StateTransitionRequest struct used for requesting state transitions within the lifecycle management system, referencing ApplicationContext and ILifecycleManager.

classes.name: StateTransitionRequest
classes.description: A struct representing a request to transition to a specific lifecycle state, holding a reference to the application context and the target state.

methods.name: StateTransitionRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the request with application context and target lifecycle state.
